name: 5-MAPDI
summary: 5-MAPDI (also known as Indanylmethylaminopropane or IMP) is an entactogenic amphetamine derivative which is structurally related to MDMA as well as to dihydrobenzofuran derivatives such as 5-MAPDB and 6-MAPDB, and has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: 5-MAPDI (also known as Indanylmethylaminopropane or IMP) is an entactogenic amphetamine derivative which is structurally related to MDMA as well as to dihydrobenzofuran derivatives such as 5-MAPDB and 6-MAPDB, and has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Related compounds such as 5-MAPDB and MDMA release serotonin, and it is thought to work in a similar way.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。5-MAPDB與MDMA等相關化合物會釋放血清素，一般認為它的作用方式相似。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。5-MAPDB与MDMA等相关化合物会释放血清素，一般认为它的作用方式相似。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its nickname IMP comes from its other name, indanylmethylaminopropane. The indane ring at its core is a benzene ring fused to a five-carbon ring, built entirely of carbon with no oxygen at all.
fact.zh: 它的暱稱「IMP」來自另一個名稱indanylmethylaminopropane。它核心的茚環是苯環與一個五碳環相連而成，全部由碳組成，完全不含氧。
fact.zhHans: 它的暱称「IMP」来自另一个名称indanylmethylaminopropane。它内核的茚环是苯环与一个五碳环相连而成，全部由碳组成，完全不含氧。
